rule: An 'expected direction' is stated only where the source publication of the dataset reports TNF and/or IL-6 after LPS restimulation for that arm. Other arms get 'no sourced expectation'.

GSE212282.citation: Ferreira AV, et al. Dimethyl itaconate induces long-term innate immune responses and confers protection against infection. Cell Rep 2023;42:112658
GSE212282.text_source: open-access PDF (CC BY 4.0), Radboud repository handle 2066/295307
GSE212282.protocol: monocytes exposed 24 h, rested 5 days, restimulated on day 6 with 10 ng/mL LPS for 24 h; cytokines in supernatant (protein). The deposited RNA-seq restimulation is 4 h LPS at day 6 (Figure 2A/2F), so protein expectations are at a later time point than the scored RNA.

GSE185433.citation: Schrijver DP, Roring RJ, et al. Resolving sepsis-induced immunoparalysis via trained immunity by targeting interleukin-4 to myeloid cells. Nat Biomed Eng 2023
GSE185433.protocol: monocytes exposed 24 h, 5-day rest, restimulated on day 6 with LPS for 24 h; TNF and IL-6 by ELISA (protein). The deposited RNA-seq restimulation samples are d6 + LPS.

GSE212282:beta_glucan.readout: TNF-a and IL-6 protein, 24 h LPS restimulation at day 6
GSE212282:beta_glucan.quote: DMI-exposed macrophages (DMI-Mfs) showed increased TNF-a and IL-6 secretion after LPS restimulation, in a similar magnitude as the well-described inducer of trained immunity b-glucan (Figure 1D, left panels).

GSE212282:DMI.readout: TNF-a and IL-6 protein, 24 h LPS restimulation at day 6
GSE212282:DMI.quote: DMI-exposed macrophages (DMI-Mfs) showed increased TNF-a and IL-6 secretion after LPS restimulation

GSE212282:itaconate.readout: IL-6 protein, 24 h LPS restimulation at day 6
GSE212282:itaconate.quote: exposure to ITA led to increased production of interleukin-6 (IL-6), and OI treatment led to enhanced tumor necrosis factor a (TNF-a) secretion, both upon restimulation (Figures 1B and 1C).
GSE212282:itaconate.note: the TNF increase is reported for 4-octyl itaconate (OI), which is not an arm of GSE212282

GSE212282:beta_glucan_plus_DMI.quote: the transcriptional response triggered by the combined exposure of DMI and b-glucan was largely similar to the individual DMI or b-glucan treatment
GSE212282:beta_glucan_plus_DMI.note: no TNF/IL-6 restimulation result is reported for the combination; the paper recalls earlier work in which DMI blunted b-glucan training, and reports that DMI blocked the early (4 h) b-glucan-driven increase of TLR, TNF and NF-kB pathway genes

GSE185433:IL4.readout: TNF and IL-6 protein, 24 h LPS restimulation at day 6
GSE185433:IL4.quote: Contrary to our initial hypothesis, exposing monocytes to IL4 alone for 24 h induced a trained immunity phenotype on day 6 (Fig. 1e). Besides enhanced production of pro-inflammatory cytokines, ...

GSE185433:IL4_plus_LPS.note: the paper reports IL-4 + LPS only as an acute (24 h) co-stimulation, where IL-4 inhibited TNF and IL-6 (Figure 1b), not after a rest and restimulation

GSE185433:LPS_tolerised.note: the source paper's in vitro experiments do not report TNF/IL-6 for monocytes pre-exposed to LPS in vitro and restimulated on day 6; LPS pre-exposure appears only in the ex vivo endotoxaemia arm ('LPS (to assess initial immune tolerance)'), restimulated on day 3 rather than day 6

erratum: v1 labelled the GSE212282 arm 'DMI' as '4OI' (4-octyl itaconate). The deposited files (e.g. A_d7_DMI), the GEO overall design and the source paper all say dimethyl itaconate (DMI); 4-OI is not an arm of this series.
